register_metric_recorders: register metric recorders including Log, JSONL, TensorBoard, and W&B into a fairseq2 DependencyContainer
register_metric_descriptors: register standard metric descriptors like loss, accuracy, BLEU, WER, and timing into a DependencyContainer
create_composite_recorder: create a CompositeMetricRecorder that aggregates Log, JSONL, TensorBoard, and W&B recorders via dependency injection
configure_wandb_recorder: configure an optional W&B metric recorder and run factory using wandb.init in the dependency container
configure_tensorboard_recorder: configure an optional TensorBoard metric recorder factory in the dependency container for experiment logging
